quotes.title: HD 176693
quotes.card: HD 176693, also known as Kepler-408, is a star with a close orbiting exoplanet in the northern constellation of Draco.
quotes.introduction: It is located at a distance of 291 light years from the Sun based on parallax measurements, but it is drifting closer with a radial velocity of −55 km/s.
